meta.title: Membership Management for Business Associations | CLUBCORE
meta.description: Built for business associations and B2B networks. CLUBCORE brings members, events, groups and reporting together on one platform — and feeds it into the AI tools you already use.

hero.headline:
Your network's memory.

Not another chatbot.
hero.sub: CLUBCORE brings members, events, groups and finances into one platform — and feeds it straight into ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot. Less admin for your team. More time for your members.

problem.headline:
Your data lives in five systems.

Your AI knows none of them.
problem.sub: Spreadsheets for members, e-conomic for invoices, email for newsletters — and ChatGPT for everything nobody can remember. None of it talks to each other.

p1.title: Scattered member data
p1.desc: Core data, activities and payments live in spreadsheets and separate systems that are never in sync.

p2.title: Events are manual work
p2.desc: Registrations, waitlists and name badges handled by hand — event after event.

p3.title: No single view
p3.desc: The board asks about growth and churn. The answer isn't in one place.

p4.title: Your AI doesn't know your network
p4.desc: ChatGPT and Claude are great writers — but know nothing about your members unless someone feeds them manually.

ai.headline:
We're not building a chatbot.

We give your AI a memory.
ai.sub: CLUBCORE structures your network's knowledge — members, events, groups, finances — and makes it available to the AI tools your consultants already use. No new interface to learn.

pt1.title: Open, via MCP
pt1.desc: The MCP standard means your AI tool can pull context directly — no manual export.

pt2.title: You own the data
pt2.desc: Everything is hosted in the EU. Nothing leaves your network unless you actively connect it.

pt3.title: Works with what you have
pt3.desc: ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or your own tool — CLUBCORE is the context layer, not another interface.

f4.headline: Data that talks back.
f4.desc: Growth, engagement and churn reasons — ready for the board and ready for action.

faq.headline: Questions.
faq.q1: How quickly can we get started?
faq.a1: Typically 3–7 days including data import and setup.
faq.q2: Are we locked into a long contract?
faq.a2: No, the contract renews annually — with full flexibility.
faq.a3: Yes — all data is hosted securely within the EU.
faq.q4: Can we import existing member data?
faq.a4: Yes, we help with import from spreadsheets, e-conomic and other systems.
faq.q5: What happens to our data when we connect AI tools?
faq.a5: Data only leaves CLUBCORE when you actively connect an AI tool via MCP. You always decide what's shared.
